text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three years spent training with Air
Groove are
coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gave a performance in the Twinkle
Series
worthy of the moniker of Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And even more challenges await us on
the
horizon.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Can you tell us about your
plans for
the future?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any intention to run
internationally?
Are there any rivals in
the younger generation
you have your
eye on?

text_block_list.name: Training Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, it's Air Groove! As cool and
elegant
as ever!

text_block_list.name: Training Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look at her, surrounded by reporters
like that.
Being the Empress is something
else...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the track in search of Air
Groove only to
find her in the middle of
a crowd of reporters and
other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember back when I spent a whole
day biding
my time and waiting for a
chance to talk to Air
Groove because
she seemed so busy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She realized what I was doing back then
and gave
me a stern talking-to after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's odd, but that memory is strangely
comforting
now. I keep my gaze focused
on her, and...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Apologies, I must be going. My trainer
needs
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove takes my hand and pulls me
away with
her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious, the reporters have
been out
in full force recently. It really
makes it difficult to
practice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. We're least likely to
be
bothered here.
choice_data_list: Did we really need to backtrack all the way here though?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I have something to
say to
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What was with that show earlier? That's
how you
think you can get my attention?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You were like a sigh in the wind. You
need to do
much better than that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What am I going to do with you? Puff
out that
chest! Be more confident!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: After all... you're this empress's trainer.
